question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Gobble
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Nibble.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Gobble"** means to eat something hurriedly and noisily. (गड़गड़ाहट से खाना)

 
 
• **Example: **He gobbled up his dinner in just a few minutes.
 
 
 
• **"Nibble" **refers to eating small bites of food slowly. (कुतरना)
 
 
• **Example: **She nibbled on a piece of cheese while reading her book.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Gobble' **is **'Nibble'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Nibble.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Small **(छोटा): Of a size that is less than normal or usual.

 
 
• **Example:** The small puppy fit comfortably in her lap.
 
 
 
• **Guzzle **(गटगट करना): Drink greedily or quickly.
 
 
• **Example: **He guzzled the soda straight from the bottle.
 
 
 
• **Grab** (पकड़ना): Take hold of something suddenly and roughly.
 
 
• **Example:** She grabbed her keys and rushed out of the house.
